info.description: This API replays persisted records, captures bounded ideas, and may save a user-confirmed project intent without creating Brief evidence. It cannot upload G-code, select a printer, heat hardware, move hardware, or start manufacturing.
info.summary: Evidence replay, conversation, and confirmed project-intent persistence.
info.title: Ariad Fabrication Journey API

post.description: Capture one idea without persistence, model inference, or execution.

422.description: The prompt is empty or exceeds the bounded intake contract.

200.description: Bounded binary snapshot whose bytes passed recorded size and SHA-256 checks.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename encoded according to RFC 5987.

ETag.description: Quoted recorded SHA-256 of the returned snapshot.

413.description: Artifact exceeds the verified-download resource ceiling.
